sources.entry: Aspect - Photo organization app with peer-to-peer sync. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Aspect
summary.one_liner: Aspect is a digital asset manager for photographers that organizes photos with collections and syncs libraries peer-to-peer between devices without cloud storage.
use_cases: organize photos by event or project
keep a photo library in sync across several computers
manage large RAW and video files without uploading to the cloud
browse photos through the file system
replace star ratings and color labels with named collections
summary.what_it_does: Aspect combines albums, tags, color labels, star ratings and folder hierarchies into a single concept called collections, which can be previewed in smart modes. It supports organizing photos by events or projects, by date, or both at once. Its peer-to-peer synchronization keeps the library accessible across multiple devices without relying on cloud storage. The organization within Aspect is mirrored to the computer's file system, and changes made in the file system are recognized by the app. The page states the software is open and transparent rather than stored in an opaque database.
notable: Peer-to-peer sync across devices without cloud storage
Collections combine albums, tags, labels, ratings and folders
Library mirrored to the file system and changes picked up both ways
Built by former Nik Software team members
caveats: Pricing and supported operating systems are not stated on the page
Listed as freeware in the awesome-mac list, but the page itself does not state pricing
